claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 makes the rewritten NCCL backend the default for every nccl process group, with TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0 or the nccl-legacy backend as rollback paths.
claims.excerpt: In 2.15 it is the default for every nccl process group, with TORCH_DIST_USE_NCCL2=0 and the nccl-legacy backend name as rollback paths.

claims.claim_text: The PyTorch Foundation says the 2.15 release is composed of 3,117 commits from 583 contributors since PyTorch 2.14.
claims.excerpt: This release is composed of 3,117 commits from 583 contributors since PyTorch 2.14.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 adds a backend-agnostic flight recorder that writes a post-mortem to disk when a collective hangs.
claims.excerpt: a backend-agnostic flight recorder writes a post-mortem to disk when a collective hangs

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 adds a torch.distributed one-sided transport API with NIXL as the first backend, with transfers capturable in CUDA graphs.
claims.excerpt: torch.distributed gains a Python transport API for one-sided data movement, with NIXL as the first backend.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch says the new MPS grouped_mm gemv path gives 1.32–1.34x higher MoE decode throughput on an M3 Ultra.
claims.excerpt: the new MPS grouped_mm has a gemv path that gives 1.32–1.34x higher MoE decode throughput on an M3 Ultra.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch says QR of a 512 x 512 matrix on MPS falls from about 7 seconds to 1.5 ms.
claims.excerpt: QR of a 512 x 512 matrix falls from about 7 seconds to 1.5 ms

claims.claim_text: The default PyTorch wheel moves to CUDA 13.2, with CUDA 13.4 wheels shipping alongside it and adding experimental support for NVIDIA Rubin GPUs.
claims.excerpt: The default PyTorch wheel moves to CUDA 13.2 (13.2.2 toolkit), with CUDA 13.4 GA wheels shipping alongside it

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 drops Python 3.10 support, requiring Python 3.11 or newer, and Dynamo adds Python 3.15 support.
claims.excerpt: PyTorch 2.15 requires Python 3.11 or newer: 3.10 wheels are no longer built, and 3.10 is no longer tested in CI.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 requires macOS 15 or newer for MPS acceleration; macOS 14 is no longer supported.
claims.excerpt: PyTorch 2.15 requires macOS 15 or newer for MPS (Apple Silicon GPU) acceleration.

claims.claim_text: PyTorch 2.15 adds ROCm 10.0 wheels, and all ROCm wheels are now built on AMD's TheRock packages.
claims.excerpt: PyTorch 2.15 adds ROCm 10.0 wheels alongside the ROCm 7.14 wheels introduced in 2.14. All ROCm wheels are now built on AMD’s TheRock packages
